tips.text: Start a Tier 5 bounty and ignore its objective; just scout the Plains for Thumpers.
Slow or freeze the Thumper with Nova, Jade, Khora, Sevagoth, Rhino Stomp or Zenurik's Void Blast.
Strip its armor first with Jade, Mag, Caliban, Grendel, Nekros or a Shattering Impact weapon like Sarpa or Stropha.
Bring a Voidrig Necramech with Arquebex to melt it; Jade plus Arquebex killed one in under half a minute.
Return to Cetus and re-enter after a kill to reset spawns instead of waiting for another.
Fly low and listen for the rumble near Mount Nang camp and the seaside ruins; Domas are more common in the north half.
Use a rapid-fire hitscan weapon built for boss damage attenuation, such as Felarx, Laetum Incarnon or Phenmor, on the leg weak spots.
Squad up so several people search for Thumpers at once.
Try Narmer bounties; they spawn Thumpers fast and often once you fast travel north and fly.
Bring Nekros for extra drop rolls per Thumper, though one poster doubted it helps the blueprint.
Do not return to the Cetus gate with the bounty failed right after the blueprint drops; one player lost it that way.
Stockpile Mawfish Bones by fishing while you wait on Thumper spawns.
Farm a little each day; reports run from the first Thumper to 30 or more kills, and spawns swing wildly.
Players treat Korrudo as Mastery fodder and call the Thumper hunt their last Mastery grind.
